title: Acquitted on All Counts, Then Guilty of Bribing a Juror

lines.say: Acquitted on all counts. And the government says he was the one who collected two hundred thousand dollars in cash to bribe one of its jurors.
lines.show: Acquitted on all counts. And the government says he was the one who collected $200,000 in cash to bribe one of its jurors.

lines.say: Said Farah was on trial in the Feeding Our Future fraud case. The bribe went to Juror fifty-two. She called the police.
lines.show: Said Farah was on trial in the Feeding Our Future fraud case. The bribe went to Juror 52. She called the police.

scene.src: Gov't sentencing memo, Abdiaziz Farah (D. Minn. 24-cr-173, Dkt. 216)

lines.say: The remaining jurors acquitted him. The government's word for it: ironically.
lines.show: The remaining jurors acquitted him. The government's word for it: "ironically."

scene.src: Gov't sentencing memo, Said Farah (D. Minn. 24-cr-173, Dkt. 251)

lines.say: Then he pleaded guilty to bribing a juror. Six and a half years.
lines.show: Then he pleaded guilty to bribing a juror. Six and a half years.
